title: Practice 2: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Everyone get out of the twilight!
exercises.why: **выйти** (the infinitive) (to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **выходить**. — Wiktionary, «выйти» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**вы-** — Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting. Antonym: в- Example: Она вышла из кабинета. — She exited the office. Prepositional phrases: из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «The verbs входить (to enter, to come in, to go in) and выходить (to come out, to go out) belong to the 2nd ("-и-") type of conjugation. They are conjugated exactly like the verb ходить: я вхожу, ты входишь … они входят; я выхожу, ты выходишь … они выходят.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  The other choice: **войти** (**войти**) has the prefix в-, во- — Movement inwards across a threshold, entering.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Thus, the roots of motion verbs convey the lexical information of manner of movement, e.g. walking, crawling, running, whereas prefixes denote path, e.g. motion in and out of space. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **влетела** is the past tense (feminine) of **влететь** (to fly into; (colloquial) to run into (to enter while running), to burst into) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **влетать**. past: он влете́л · она влете́ла · оно влете́ло · они влете́ли. — Wiktionary, «влететь» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**в-, во-** — Movement inwards across a threshold, entering. Antonym: вы- Example: Трамвай остановился, и девушка вошла. — The tram stopped and the girl entered. Prepositional phrases: в / на + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  The other choice: **вылетела** (**вылететь**) has the prefix вы- — Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Thus, the roots of motion verbs convey the lexical information of manner of movement, e.g. walking, crawling, running, whereas prefixes denote path, e.g. motion in and out of space. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

Antonym: вы- Example: Трамвай остановился, и девушка вошла. — The tram stopped and the girl entered. The other choice: **вынесем** (**вынести**) has the prefix вы- — Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: **влетит** is the future tense (3rd person singular) of **влететь** (to fly into; (colloquial) to run into (to enter while running), to burst into) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **влетать**. future: я влечу́ · ты влети́шь · он влети́т · мы влети́м · вы влети́те · они влетя́т. — Wiktionary, «влететь» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**в-, во-** — Movement inwards across a threshold, entering. Antonym: вы- Example: Трамвай остановился, и девушка вошла. — The tram stopped and the girl entered. Prepositional phrases: в / на + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  The other choice: **вылетит** (**вылететь**) has the prefix вы- — Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
